name: EvoEval
description: EvoEval is a program synthesis benchmark suite that evolves existing coding benchmarks into diverse targeted domains to provide a comprehensive and robust evaluation of LLM coding abilities, addressing issues like data leakage and limited problem variety.
reputation: A recent coding benchmark suite from the program synthesis literature that has gained attention for leakage-resistant evaluation, but it is not yet broadly adopted as a standard leaderboard benchmark.
notes: Shows significant performance drops compared to standard benchmarks, indicating overfitting in existing benchmarks; supports evolving problems to keep pace with LLM advances.
